headline: Nibe Limited receives new credit rating from rating agency
hook: New credit rating assigned to Nibe
summary: NIBE Limited has formally informed the stock exchanges that it has received a new credit rating. The company submitted this update for compliance purposes. No further details regarding the rating score or agency were provided in this initial disclosure. Retail investors should check subsequent company filings for the specific rating details.
whats_next: Detailed credit rating report filing by the company
why_it_matters: Credit rating updates may influence borrowing costs for the company.

headline: Nibe files AGM scrutinizer's report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Nibe Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a standard post-AGM compliance filing required for listed companies. For Indian retail investors, such routine filings do not impact business operations or share price. The disclosure simply completes the administrative process of the recent shareholder meeting.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price
